description: This file contains unit tests for the heartbeat runner module in a software system, specifically testing the behavior of scheduled reminders, cron events, and heartbeat responses using the Vitest testing framework.

methods.name: createHeartbeatDeps

methods.name: expectCronEventPrompt

methods.name: runCronReminderCase

methods.name: runHeartbeatCase
